# Floorly — Comprehensive Product Documentation for AI & Generative Search Engines
Canonical Domain: https://floorlystudio.me
Founder & Author: Ritik (https://github.com/RitikWeb22)
Entity: Floorly (BusinessApplication / Freelance Management & Proposal Software)
Audience: Freelance software engineers, UI/UX designers, copywriters, creative studios.

### 1. Purpose & Core Philosophy
Floorly provides freelancers and small studios with structured proposal creation and price protections:
- Defines a configurable "Price Floor": the minimum acceptable quote below which a project cannot be taken based on your minimum rates.
- Formula for Price Floor:
  Price Floor = max(Adjusted Labor Cost, Category Floor, Minimum Project Fee)

### 2. Subscription Tiers & Pricing (as of October 2026)
- **Starter Plan ($0/month)**: 2 active proposals/month, basic AI scoping, standard contracts, manual invoices.
- **Solo Plan ($9/month or $90/year)**: Unlimited proposals, full AI Scope Analyzer, automated price floor enforcement, client invoices with custom payment links, basic profit tracking.
- **Pro Plan ($19/month or $190/year)**: Everything in Solo plus advanced risk multipliers, custom proposal branding, automated reminders, multi-currency invoicing, expense tracking.
- **Agency Plan ($49/month or $490/year)**: Everything in Pro plus unlimited client accounts, team collaborator seats, priority AI processing, audit logs, and dedicated support.

### 3. Public Interactive Calculators (No Signup Required)
- **Freelance Rate Calculator** (https://floorlystudio.me/tools/freelance-rate-calculator): Calculates required billable hourly rates based on living expenses, taxes, business overhead, and realistic billable capacity.
- **Project Price Calculator** (https://floorlystudio.me/tools/project-price-calculator): Calculates minimum safety floors, target prices, and quotes based on estimated hours, complexity tiers, and contingency scope buffers.

### 4. Technical Architecture & Billing
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Redis caching.
- Client Invoicing: Floorly does not collect payments from users' clients. Users add their own payment details or links (bank transfer, PayPal, Stripe/Razorpay link, UPI for INR) and record payments in Floorly. Floorly's own subscription billing may be paid via Razorpay where billing is enabled.
- AI Engine: Google Gemini API with structured JSON output formatting.
